source: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, read with the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (see https://consumeraffairs.gov.in/pages/legal-metrology-act)

rules.title: MRP must be declared
rules.description: Every pre-packaged commodity must declare the Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes.

rules.title: Net quantity must be declared in standard units
rules.description: Net quantity must be declared in standard SI units (g, kg, ml, l, or count for numbers).

rules.title: Manufacturer name and address must be declared
rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer/packer/importer must be declared.

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture must be declared
rules.description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed must be declared.

rules.title: Consumer care details must be declared
rules.description: Name, address, telephone/email of consumer care/complaints contact must be declared.

rules.title: Unit Sale Price must be declared for applicable categories
rules.description: Sale price per unit (per kg/litre) must be declared where applicable.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) read with Rule 18, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Country of origin declaration (2026 amendment)
rules.description: Imported pre-packaged commodities must clearly declare country of origin on the principal display panel.

rules.title: 'Not for retail sale' declaration for institutional/industrial packages
rules.description: Packages meant for institutional or industrial consumers (who obtain the product directly from the manufacturer, not via retail sale) are exempt from the standard Chapter II declarations, but must instead bear a clear 'Not for retail sale' marking on the package.

rules.title: MRP declaration for garment/hosiery sold loose
rules.description: Garments or hosiery sold loose or open at the point of sale (Rule 26(f), inserted 2022, amended 2023) are exempt from most Chapter II declarations, but must still declare the MRP inclusive of all taxes, along with manufacturer/brand owner name and address.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 26(f), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (inserted by the Third Amendment Rules, 2022, effective 1 Jan 2023; amended by the Amendment Rules, 2023)
